content:
maria: Heads up — main is red after the prod-config merge, several GHA jobs failing with decrypt errors on self-hosted runners. Anyone else seeing KMS decrypt failures?

maria: paste from job log:
```
[2026-03-10T12:34:01Z] vault: decrypt failed: permission denied: key version mismatch (kms:DecryptDenied)
Error: failed to get secret: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = kms:DecryptDenied for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/runner-key
```

cheng: Yep — spotted the same around 00:30 UTC. Looks like the runners started getting 403s from KMS during decrypt. OIDC exchange to get short-lived creds works, but KMS denies Decrypt.

alex: Can someone try a manual rerun of the failing job in the GH UI? Want to see if it's flaky or deterministic.

maria: kicked a rerun for the workflow attached to PR #1245 — it gets queued on self-hosted then fails with the same decrypt error.

infra-oncall: We did a scheduled rotation of runner-key at 02:00 UTC (v3 -> v4). That should have been transparent but looks like the IAM binding that allows the gha service account to use the key didn't get re-applied to v4. Investigating now.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: detected key rotation for runner-key (v3 -> v4). Auto-apply iam-binding job started.

sree: If ops can reapply the binding quickly we can rerun. For triage — which build first failed? I can bisect if needed.

maria: first bad build number is 1123, commit 716a2b0. Marking this blocking main for now.

cheng: quick workaround: switch the sensitive decrypt step to a GitHub-managed runner or fallback to a cached secret until IAM is fixed (not ideal). Also granting cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to gha-sa at the key level has fixed this before.

alex: Who has permission to update key IAM for prod? This needs approval if touching prod keys.

infra-oncall: I can apply the binding but need ticket approval. Opened OPS-789 and pinged security. ETA ~15-25m. Will apply the binding and restart runner fleet afterward.

maria: I've requested a rerun after the binding fix. Also adding a bisect request — @cheng, can you run a quick bisection across 700..720 to rule out code change?

cheng: Starting bisection now against commit range 700..720. Will test on a small subset of jobs pinned to managed runner vs self-hosted.

ci-bot: rerun requested by maria for build 1123 (jobs queued).

cheng: Quick update — bisection narrowed it to 711..713. Failure reproduces only on self-hosted runners, passes on managed runners. That points to infra/KMS rather than application code.

infra-oncall: IAM binding reapplied and gha-runner service restarted on fleet. I also rotated the runner image to pick up latest vault-agent fix.

maria: Rerun after the fix — build 1123 now passed :tada: Thanks everyone.

alex: Follow-up action items:
- add a CI preflight step that validates KMS decrypt with the runner identity before running heavy matrix
- add monitoring alert when KMS DecryptDenied spikes for runner-key
- document runbook for key rotation impact on self-hosted runners

maria: Created PR to add the preflight check and tagged @eng-infra for review.

sree: I'll add the alert to the infra dashboard and link the runbook in the PR.

maria: Closing the thread once CI stays green for 2 successful runs. Thanks all.
